description.zh:
达量停用后，次月是否自动复用。

- true（默认值）：次月自动复用。

- false：次月不自动复用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically resume the card in the following month after it is suspended due to reaching the data cap.

- true (default): Automatically resume in the following month.

- false: Do not automatically resume in the following month.

description.zh:
达量停用的数值，仅支持正整数，单位：MB。

当月流量达到此数值时将自动停用，可主动复用。
description.en:
The data cap threshold for suspension. Only positive integers are supported. Unit: MB.

When the monthly data usage reaches this value, the card is automatically suspended. You can manually resume the card.

description.zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在[物联网SIM服务控制台](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面查看ICCID。
description.en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can view the ICCID on the IoT card or on the Card Management page of the [IoT SIM Service console](https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8).

title.zh: 设置卡的达量停用规则
title.en: Set data cap suspension rule for a card

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

The maximum number of times that a single Alibaba Cloud account can invoke this operation per second (QPS) is 20.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
